{
  "name": "ts-band",
  "version": "0.8.0",
  "description": "Tailscale nodes' state in a band above the prompt, with a toast when a node comes up or goes down",
  "author": {
    "name": "hoobnn",
    "url": "https://github.com/hoobnn"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "repository": "https://github.com/hoobnn/hoobnn-agent-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "tailscale",
    "network",
    "band",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "visible": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the band",
      "description": "Show the band; /ts off and /ts on set this too",
      "default": true
    },
    "tailscalePath": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "tailscale CLI",
      "description": "Path to the tailscale CLI; empty looks on PATH, then Homebrew and the macOS app",
      "default": ""
    },
    "intervalSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh interval (s)",
      "description": "Seconds between reads of tailscale status (at least 10)",
      "default": 60
    },
    "nodes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nodes",
      "description": "Hosts to show, comma separated, in this order; host=label renames one; empty shows every node",
      "default": ""
    },
    "hideOffline": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hide offline nodes",
      "description": "Leave offline nodes out of the band (they still count in the total)",
      "default": false
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the band, toasts and /ts; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh-Hans",
        "zh-Hant",
        "ja",
        "ko",
        "es",
        "fr",
        "de",
        "pt-BR",
        "ru"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    }
  }
}
